title: Generic swap and reverse
prompt: Implement in `Solution`: `static void Swap<T>(T[] items, int i, int j)` swapping in place (throws `ArgumentOutOfRangeException` for out-of-range indices), and `static T[] Reversed<T>(T[] items)` returning a NEW array in reverse order (null/empty → empty array, never null).

tests.name: normal
tests.hint: Swap mutates the caller's array; Reversed must not.

tests.name: edges
tests.hint: Both contracts: indices validated, null-input normalized to an empty array.
